lines: Obtained by that knowledge-mantra-yoga, this person also, artificial, like a yogī, then from the heart of the sādhya abandons identification.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tajjñānamantrayogāptaḥ puruṣaścaiṣa kṛtrimam yogīva sādhyahṛdayāttadā tādātmyamujjhati
